title: HTB: Nimbus
caption: The path from the preview form to root on the host.
description: Nimbus is a Hard Linux box built around a fake AWS. An SSRF with an octal-IP bypass reaches the metadata service, the stolen role can only write to an SQS queue, and a worker that exec()s the job YAML turns that into code execution inside a privileged CodeBuild container. A function-export trick keeps root, and mounting the host disk escapes to the real machine.
